stories.title: Russian attack triggers explosions near Kyiv, 6 injured, 165 evacuated
stories.reason: A strike on an enterprise in the Bucha district sparked a major fire and secondary explosions, with rescue crews forced to pause repeatedly during air raid alerts.

stories.title: Norway's King Harald V dies at 89, his son becomes King Haakon VIII
stories.reason: Europe's oldest monarch, who fled the Nazi invasion as a child and helped modernize Norway's monarchy over 35 years, has died, ending an era for the Norwegian royal house.

stories.title: BLS revises U.S. job growth down 79,000 in preliminary benchmark update
stories.reason: Downward revisions concentrated in retail, health services and finance mark the seventh time in eight years the benchmark update has pushed U.S. employment estimates lower, deepening concern about labor-market weakness.

stories.title: Nvidia pauses AI cloud revenue-sharing deals amid antitrust concerns
stories.reason: Nvidia pulled back its AI Compute Partnership financing program just weeks after launch after employees flagged antitrust risk in how much control it sought over customers' businesses -- a sign of growing regulatory sensitivity around Nvidia's market power.

stories.title: Six months since the war on Iran began, its costs are still climbing
stories.reason: As the conflict approaches its half-year mark, higher US fuel prices and extended military deployments underscore how a war meant to be brief has become a lingering drag on both economies.
